title: Software Engineer, Backend (Trading)
text:
Phantom https://phantom.com is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.



Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/sites/ninabambysheva/2026/02/23/inside-phantoms-battle-plan-to-win-the-crypto-fueled-superapp-war/ and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/! 



We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.




RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Software Engineer at Phantom, you’ll play a key role in building the systems that power our trading experiences. You’ll design and implement APIs, data pipelines, and services that bridge the gap between blockchain infrastructure and the seamless, intuitive experiences our users expect.

In this role, you’ll focus on the implementation and aggregation of new trading protocols, aggregators, and trade types, as well as experimenting with new trading surfaces and user segments. Your work will directly shape the future of how users discover, execute, and interact with digital asset trades across multiple ecosystems.

 - Feature development: You will be owning features on our web platforms – currently the Phantom Extension https://phantom.app/download and our website.

 - New initiatives and products: You will be leading initiatives to add support for other blockchains to Phantom, and to launch new complementary products or infrastructure.

 - Interfacing with users: You will be interfacing directly with end-users and developers building on Phantom – supporting them and collecting feedback to inform the direction of the product.

 - Team building: You will be working with the team to create and foster a culture of raising the bar with each new hire.
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience

 - 5+ years full-time software engineering experience

 - Demonstrated interest in open and community-driven platforms

 - Nice-To-Have: Experience working with trading systems

 - English language proficiency
   

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.



Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

 - Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

 - Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

 - Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundati

title: Virologist – AI Safety and Evaluations
text:
About 10a Labs: 10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.

Location & Travel Expectations

We are primarily seeking candidates based in the Washington, DC, New York City, San Francisco Bay Area, and Denver metropolitan areas. Candidates hired in these locations will be expected to work from a 10a Labs office at least two days per week.

All new hires will participate in in-person onboarding in Washington, DC, New York City, or San Francisco during their first week. Occasional travel may also be required for interviews, in-person meetings, and other business needs.
Position Overview

We are seeking a Virologist with expertise in virology, microbiology, and biosecurity to support the design and execution of technical evaluations of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs).

The ideal candidate will have a strong scientific background in biological research, an understanding of dual-use biological risks, and an interest in evaluating the capabilities and potential misuse risks of emerging AI technologies.

This role will focus on developing scientifically rigorous benchmarks, designing and conducting model evaluations, and assessing AI-generated scientific outputs for technical accuracy, feasibility, and potential implications for biological safety and security. The candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary teams of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers to develop evaluation methodologies and communicate findings to stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop scientific benchmarks and evaluation methodologies to assess the biological knowledge, reasoning, and technical capabilities of advanced AI models.

Conduct model capability evaluations and red-teaming exercises to assess potential biological misuse risks associated with advanced AI systems.

Develop scientifically grounded evaluation scenarios, questions, and tasks spanning virology, microbiology, and other relevant biological domains.

Assess AI-generated scientific outputs for technical accuracy, feasibility, completeness, and potential implications for biosecurity.

Identify and characterize potential misuse scenarios involving biological agents, dual-use research, and emerging AI capabilities.

Contribute to the development of evaluation criteria, scoring rubrics, and methodologies for measuring model performance and potential capability uplift.

Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and subject matter experts to develop and implement scalable evaluation approaches, including automated benchmarks.

Analyze evaluation results, identify patterns in model capabilities and limitations, and contribute to technical reports and client deliverables.

Stay informed of emerging developments in biological research, AI capabilities, biosecurity risks, and relevant AI safety frameworks to inform evaluation design.

Minimum Qualifications

PhD in Virology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or a closely related biological science, or equivalent practical experience.

Research experience involving pathogenic viruses, bacteria, or other biologically relevant systems.

Strong understanding of biological research methods, experimental design, and the technical challenges associated with biological research and development.

Demonstrated knowledge of biosecurity principles, dual-use biological research, and potential biological misuse risks.

Experience critically evaluating scientific literature, experimental methodologies, and technical research outputs.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to assess complex scientific information for accuracy, feasibility, and technical limitations.

title: Solution Consultant - Veeva QualityOne
text:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
As part of our regional expansion in our Veeva QualityOne business, Veeva is currently looking for a Solution Consultant who has a passion for helping our customers in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Food & Beverage, and related consumer industries achieve their business vision for excellence in Quality Management.
As a key member of the Solution Consulting team, you will be responsible for working with our Account Partners to understand customers’ business challenges & needs, driving technical win strategies, and providing deep solution expertise including value-based product demonstrations of the Veeva Quality application suite.
Your contribution will be critical in driving technical sales execution to support the Veeva QualityOne Asia team as we scale our market presence across India and the region.
At Veeva, we offer excellent opportunities for our people to capitalize on their skills and grow in a fast-paced, unique and exceptional work environment.

What You’ll Do
Identify customers' challenges and objectives and demonstrate solutions that address these requirements and bring business value to the organisation

Communicate product knowledge and industry expertise to customers

Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle for all product- and technology-related inquiries

Assist the sales support team to prepare compelling, professional content for RFP (Request for Proposal) and RFI (Request for Information) responses for prospective clients

Partner with Professional Services to help define project scopes, best practices, and high-level project proposals for prospects

Support marketing initiatives and represent the company at key events, including public speaking and presentations
Requirements
4+ years of experience working for a SaaS Enterprise Software company in a customer-facing pre-sales / Solution Consulting / Technical Sales Engineering role (or related professional services consulting background)

Strong understanding of or direct exposure to Quality Management functions at Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Food & Beverage, or related process manufacturing industries

Proven track record of managing and prioritizing multi-faceted technical engagements across complex customer accounts

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated success delivering compelling technical presentations and solution demos to both technical and executive audiences

Self-reliant with a strong ability to drive initiatives, operate autonomously in a remote or hybrid environment, and collaborate effectively with remote multi-disciplinary teams

Full professional fluency in English with the right to work in India
Nice to Have
Direct hands-on product experience with systems such as Veeva Vault, ETQ Reliance, Sparta TrackWise, OpenText, SharePoint, Documentum D2, FirstDoc FirstPoint, NextDocs, UL ComplianceWire, SAP QM and other quality information management or content management systems

Understanding of global quality requirements, compliance considerations and processes for Quality process and content management, Consumer Products

title: Developer Engagement Team  (Contract)
text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is seeking enthusiastic individuals to join our Developer Engagement Team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong focus on understanding issues and critical thinking, alongside the essential qualities required for exceptional customer support. As a contractor of this team, you will play a crucial link between Roblox and its developer community. If you're passionate about the Roblox community and eager to contribute to the success of developers, we'd love to hear from you.

You will:

Assist in resolving creator day-to-day escalations and emergencies.

Manage communication between Roblox staff and creators.

Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and transactions, ensuring accurate documentation and timely follow-up.

Dedicate 40 hours per week with a working schedule from Saturday to Wednesday plus on-call availability throughout the week

You have:

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Demonstrates endless patience and a positive attitude.

Capable of managing time effectively.

In-depth understanding of Roblox and the Roblox community.

Solid knowledge of the technical aspects of Roblox Studio.

Experience developing on Roblox and/or other creation platforms.

 

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. Please note that not all benefits on this page are applicable to this hourly position.
Hourly Pay Range
$20—$25 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
